channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stephen Curry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stephen Curry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“I cannot even imagine a coach being luckier ever in the history of the game than I am to coach Stephen Curry,not just the player but the human being, the person. It is so fun seeing him every day. He brings light to every room that he is in, even in the dark times, and that is his magic power. I think he is someone who just brings hope and brings light and brings energy, and the way that sustains a team's journey, it just makes my job so much easier.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Oct 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cedric Ceballos on Buck Williams, Stephen Curry, Charles Oakley
item.description:
Cedric Ceballos:

“I think that's the difference in the play of the game, too. I got criticized about Stephen Curry not being able to do what he did in my era because you got Oakleys and Masons and Buck Williams that are making 100,000and you're making what you're making and you shoot a 50-footer. You get touched up in the locker room. You know what I'm saying? I know y'all have Magic on here a lot, he talk about that. People getting in the fights with each other and Oakley slapping the shit out of them and all that. They because the dollar amount. So if I'm making 60 to 80, shoot that shit, Steph. I don't give a fuck. I'm making 60 to 80. I don't have to lose teeth to make what those guys was making.”

Cedric Ceballos on Buck Williams, Stephen Curry, Charles Oakley, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Steph Curry's contract extension:

“It didn't surprise anyone. Steph is obviously still making a ton of money, but he's very unselfish and understands that this pickupwill allow us next summer to sign better players, more players.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Oct 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Yaxel Lendeborg on the slip cut in a scrimmage off Steph Curry’s gravity:

“I’ve never come off a screen and seen nobody in front or behind me.”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Stephen Curry, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Teague, Ellis’ teammate with the Indiana Pacers in 2016-2017 wasn’t exactly buying it.

“Imma keep it real with you. He was never better than Steph Curry,”

Jeff Teague on Stephen Curry, Aug 11, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Stephen Curry
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell:

“I would love to see Stephen Curry go to Boston. Boston? Yeah, I would love to see that. Just because I think he needs that type of help around him now. Like who who's taking the load off him in Golden State? The rookie? Is Jimmy? Oh yeah, healthy Jimmy. I think you have a veteran team that's going to know how to win the last three minutes of a game. They're going to know how to win. I just, just getting to the last three minutes is where they're going to struggle.”

D'Angelo Russell on Stephen Curry, Aug 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on LeBron James, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“Stephen Curry's legacy is already complete. It's complete. You know why it's complete? Because while everybody was talking about LeBron being No. 1 or No. 2, this little light-skinned kid dominated in LeBron's era, and he beat LeBron.”

Shaquille O'Neal on LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Andre Iguodala, the 2015 Finals MVP in the first of the Warriors' three titles over James' Cleveland Cavaliers, says that James' interest in Golden State is a testament to Stephen Curry.

“As I've been saying since 2013, Steph Curry, no one understands how great he is,”

Andre Iguodala on Stephen Curry, Jul 10, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Iguodala, who is being succeeded as NBPA executive director by former Warriors chief legal officer David Kelly, said that a recent text exchange with a friend crystalized the magnitude of James' interest in the Warriors.

“He's like, 'Steph Curry, if he's going to get another one of the greatest players of their generation to play on his team, what does it say about him?'”

Andre Iguodala on Stephen Curry, Jul 10, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Yaxel Lendeborg:

“They put my locker right next to Steph Curry. I know we got a lot of work to do to become best friends.”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Stephen Curry, Jun 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry
item.description:
“Which just lets you know the weight that the name Steph Curry carries, which lets you know that the presence that Steph Curry has, who he is, what he is, what he stands for, that they're willing to sign this a 10-year deal.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Jun 4, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“Victor Wembanyama, one of the rare few capable of changing the NBA game, like Stephen Curry, Michael Jordan, or Shaquille O'Neal.”

Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, May 28, 2026. Source: L'Equipe.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Mike Dunleavy on Steph Curry’s eventual extension talks:

“I don’t see under any scenario where we don’t want to figure out a way to have him finish here.”

Mike Dunleavy on Stephen Curry, May 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“To coach Steph Curry who is undoubtedly the greatest face of a franchise that I've ever seen in any sport. He just lets me coach him and he wants to be coached and he's just an incredible partner and collaborator. The only thing I've learned is that I'm really blessed”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Apr 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry
item.description:
While reacting to the Warriors’ 126-121 win over the Los Angeles Clippers in the play-in tournament on Twitch, Brown claimed Curry is a top-five player in NBA history.

“Steph Curry is one of the 5 greatest players to ever play this game at this point in his career,”

Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry, Apr 17, 2026. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry
item.description:
“Y’all can say whatever y’all want, fill in the rest. Steph Curry is top 5, bro. Just leadership, all of that. I’m not even trying to glaze. I promise y’all I’m not.”

Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry, Apr 17, 2026. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“When you have a leader like Steve Kerr, who always knows the right thing to say, and when you have a leader like Steph Curry, that you can always rally around,that you know is going to be there giving everything he’s got—and also one of the greatest players we’ve ever seen—when you’re following two guys like that, things like this are possible.”

Draymond Green on Steve Kerr, Stephen Curry, Apr 16, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry
item.description:
jb: Jaylen Brown on how they lost the 2022 Finals:

“We was in a drop coverage on Steph Curry. We should have never been in a drop coverage.”

Jaylen Brown on Stephen Curry, Apr 7, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Green emphasized that Kerr’s role in the Warriors dynasty is just as significant as the team’s core players, including Steph Curry and his former teammate, Klay Thompson.

“Just as much impact as Steph Curry has had, as I’ve had, as Klay’s had, Steve’s had,”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Apr 6, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Draymond Green on Steph Curry returning from injury on Sunday:

“I told you all last podcast that Steph Curry may return, I don’t know if that’s one day or five days from now. But if whether it’s one day or five days, if you go back and do the math, 5 days from when I said that, is Sunday. Steph Curry is returning on Sunday versus the Houston Rockets. And thank God, we’re excited obviously. But number one, just to see him back out there on the floor, the NBA is a much better place with Steph Curry on the floor. I think we all can agree with that.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Apr 4, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jaden Ivey on Stephen Curry
item.description:
During one of his rambling monologues, the 24-year-old Ivey even called out Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry.

“That's why you got Steph Curry, he's not even surrendered, and y'all believe he's a Christian because he wrote Philippians 4:13,”

Jaden Ivey on Stephen Curry, Mar 31, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Steve Kerr on Steph Curry’s continued absence:

“The whole idea is if he’s healthy he’s going to play. If he’s not healthy, or if there’s any risk at all, he’s not going to play. That’s just how he’s built. It’s how we’re built.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Mar 27, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Here is Draymond on his recent conversations with Curry, who he said texted him today:

“Keep going. I know it's tough, but promise you, I'm coming back.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Mar 6, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Marc Spears on Stephen Curry
item.description:
that Curry is still keen on suiting up again for Team USA in the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles.

“Steph Curry is still interested in making his second Olympic appearance. He'd be 40 years old at that time, but look, he's a shooter. He's the greatest shooter of all time. Why would you not want that on your roster?”

Marc Spears on Stephen Curry, Feb 24, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan
item.description:
“It’s what makes this issue so tricky, is that great players — Steph (Curry) and Tim Duncan, Wemby — they’re not only team-changing, but they’re franchise-changing, for even beyond the scope of those guys’ careers. “And so there’s only a handful of players that can do that, that are that valuable. And so teams are all clamoring for them. Sometimes, you don’t know who they are. Steph was the seventh pick. Giannis (Antetokounmpo) was the (15th) pick. So it’s not always the first couple guys, but more often than not, the first pick has an opportunity to be that guy, and that’s what creates this issue.”

Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, Feb 10, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Stephen Curry
item.description:
“Life evolves. I have no problem with that. Now, it’s going to mess up the records. If I’m Stephen Curry, I would be upset with that. But in 10 years, I would not be surprised if there’s a four-point line.”

Reggie Miller on Stephen Curry, Dec 24, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“And for the MVP award — I don’t know that we’ve ever seen it done before, but if we have, excuse me and I apologize — but I don’t think we’ve ever seen a 38-year-old win the MVP award. And I think Steph Curry is gonna make a run for it.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Oct 28, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brandin Podziemski on Stephen Curry
item.description:
“To be honest, not everybody wants to be as great as Steph Curry. Some people say it, but not everybody wants to,”

Brandin Podziemski on Stephen Curry, Oct 22, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Al Horford on Stephen Curry
item.description:
Al Horford on playing with Steph Curry:

“He does such a good job terrifying everyone in the league every time he moves. That’s something I’m going to really take advantage of.”

Al Horford on Stephen Curry, Oct 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chance McMillian on Stephen Curry
item.description:
“But I’ll use it as constant motivation because this is the best shooter of all time. And I’m going to use it as motivation to work hard and get where he’s at. Because not everyone in the world has a vet that’s Steph Curry.”

Chance McMillian on Stephen Curry, Oct 4, 2025. Source: New York Times.
